name: BTG Hotels (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: BTG Hotels (Group) Co., Ltd. engages in the operation and management of hotels in the People's Republic of China. It operates through two segments, Hotel Business and Scenic Spot Business. The company operates Nanshan scenic spot in Hainan. BTG Hotels (Group) Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Beijing Capital Tourism Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to BTG Hotels (Group) Co., Ltd. in August 2013. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
